bug_semantics: A rating block stores customIcon.svg as an unconstrained string and the embed renderer inserted that string directly with Solid innerHTML. An attacker who supplies a malicious imported typebot or edits a shared workspace can place active HTML such as an onerror handler in the field; when a victim previews the bot inline, it executes on the privileged builder origin rather than in the Web Worker used for blocks marked isUnsafe, yielding stored XSS and a sandbox bypass.
flaw_origin: The original member commit for PR #194 introduced the rating input model and renderer together: packages/models/src/features/blocks/inputs/rating.ts accepted customIcon.svg with z.string().optional(), while packages/js/src/features/blocks/inputs/rating/components/RatingForm.tsx selected props.customIcon.svg and passed it directly to innerHTML without sanitization. This is the first public commit object that wrote the flawed data-to-DOM mechanism; later moves, formatting changes, and accessibility refactors preserved it.
ai_marker: absent — the BIC commit object names author and committer Baptiste Arnaud <contact@baptiste-arnaud.fr>; its message is ':alembic: Implement bot v2 MVP\n\nCloses #190' and has no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, AI-tool trailer, or bot identity.
evidence: First-party advisory GHSA-6m7c-xfhp-p9fh identifies packages/embeds/js/src/features/blocks/inputs/rating/components/RatingForm.tsx and the direct fix https://github.com/baptisteArno/typebot.io/commit/474ecbf46bc47a75265bada2599f12b2179de375. `git log -L` on RatingButton traces the unsanitized innerHTML expression through later edits to mainline squash 1a3869ae6d9fa92fc71ef9d981bfffb8e4ee4ecc. GitHub's PR #194 commits endpoint identifies original member 3487850b9f4808617d347ddde4d9701f56662894. `git cat-file commit` shows that member has tree 1c7360226886e227373c9affe2a374c1fbe7c750 and parent e55823e0112291a32886908fd4c63365275106e6; mainline squash 1a3869ae6d9fa92fc71ef9d981bfffb8e4ee4ecc has the identical tree and parent, and `git diff --quiet` between the two exits 0, so the squash is fully decomposed to its sole original member. `git diff e55823e... 3487850b... -- packages/js/src/features/blocks/inputs/rating/components/RatingForm.tsx` shows the file added from /dev/null with the direct `innerHTML={... ? props.customIcon.svg : defaultIcon}` sink; `git cat-file -e e55823e...:packages/js/src/features/blocks/inputs/rating/components/RatingForm.tsx` fails because the path is absent, directly proving immediate-parent absence. The same member adds packages/models/src/features/blocks/inputs/rating.ts with svg: z.string().optional(). Mainline tag js-v0.0.1 (ef9170dcb664705270c6859de16d92ea7c8071b7) contains squash-equivalent 1a3869ae... and still shows the raw sink, establishing an affected package release. The direct one-parent fix 474ecbf46bc47a75265bada2599f12b2179de375 replaces raw rating markup with sanitizeSvgFragment, adds DOMPurify SVG sanitization at render and import sanitization in apps/builder/src/features/typebot/helpers/sanitizers.ts. It is exactly tag js-v0.9.22; it is absent from js-v0.9.21 (c258560dc47a90aa17074cde1ead5cab1c2c69d8) and contained in advisory boundary js-v0.10.1 (2c3fc7267a5e1529ba4b1a2ab4f1edb3e3b8990) and referenced v3.16.0 (7bc1a6f856f64c5ae38ecb6eb87a175b0a50c5c1), whose package version is 0.10.1. Repository tags also show the fix in js-v0.10.0 and directly released as 0.9.22, so the advisory's '< 0.10.1' range is conservative/inconsistent with source-tag history, but its named patched boundary does contain the fix.
reasoning: The causal chain begins in the sole original PR #194 member, not in its GitHub-created squash object: that member simultaneously permits arbitrary custom-icon strings and renders them as active DOM. Its immediate parent lacks the renderer path entirely. The original member and squash share both parent and tree, so using 3487850b... recovers the smallest reconstructable BIC rather than mislabeling the squash, while 1a3869ae... supplies mainline/tag ancestry. Subsequent history only preserved or moved the same raw sink until 474ecbf46... added DOMPurify-based SVG sanitization both at the embed sink and during builder sanitation, closing the stored-XSS path. Earliest package-tag evidence places the flaw in js-v0.0.1, and the fix is present by the advisory's 0.10.1/v3.16.0 boundary (indeed source tags place it earlier at 0.9.22). Finally, attribution is based only on the decomposed BIC commit object: it is human-authored and human-committed with no AI marker or trailer. Therefore the closed causal verdict is NOT_AI.
